description: Source file implementing a factory for creating a DU high clock controller, including classes for managing IO timers and cell tickers within a 3GPP-related radio system.

classes.name: io_timer_multi_source
classes.description: Manages timer ticking modes (automatic/manual) and provides manual tickers.

classes.name: du_high_time_source_impl
classes.description: Implements a high-precision clock controller with cell-specific tickers and master state management.

classes.name: du_high_time_source_impl::cell_ticker
classes.description: Represents a cell-specific ticker that interacts with the parent time source.

methods.name: create_manual_ticker
methods.description: Creates a manual ticker, switching the timer source to manual mode if it's the first.

methods.name: do_reset_ticker
methods.description: Resets the ticker, switching back to automatic mode if all manual tickers are deleted.

methods.name: do_tick
methods.description: Performs ticking of timers, accounting for missed ticks.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a cell to the clock controller, returning a cell ticker.

methods.name: get_timer_manager
methods.description: Returns reference to the timer manager.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication updates, manages master state, and triggers cell tickers.

methods.name: handle_cell_activation
methods.description: Activates a cell and initializes its ticker and master clock state.

methods.name: handle_cell_deactivation
methods.description: Deactivates a cell and updates the master state.
